introduction.situation: Arts and literature research and scholarship cover a very wide range of works in visual, performing, screen, musical and written media.
introduction.complication: The existing groups mix subject matter with catalogue labels, residual categories and duplicated headings, so the same aspect of a work is described in several unrelated places.
introduction.question: How is everything in arts and literature divided?
introduction.answer: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

key_line.mece_dimension: what feature of the work the sentence is about
key_line.rank_note: The pillars run from the material object outward to judgment of the work.

points.statement: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.
points.name: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.

support.rank_note: Sections run from fixed visual and material media to lens, screen and digital media, then to physical attributes and the practice of making.

points.name: Visual and material media are works defined by the physical substance and technique used to make an object or image.

points.statement: Print media, photography, and handicrafts are distinct kinds of visual and material art forms, each defined by the medium or technique used to make the work.

support.rank_note: Members are arranged by structure of medium, from printed works to photographic images to handmade crafted objects, not ranked by degree.

field_check.governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.
key_line: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.
Form is the feature of a work concerned with its design, structure, genre and style as it appears to the audience.
Meaning is the feature of a work concerned with what it represents, expresses and conveys through ideas and theory.
Context and reception is the feature of a work concerned with the place, language, time, industry and audience in which it is produced and received.
Value is the feature of a work concerned with how it is judged, studied historically and assigned standing within culture.
